SRINIV AS UNIVERSITY     
          INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING & TECHNOLOGY     
                 MUKKA, MANGALURU - 574146     
DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER SCIENCE  
ENGINEERING   
Srinivas Premier League (SPL) – Season 8  
 
Event Name:  Srinivas Premier League (SPL) – Season 8  
Date:  17 February 2026  
Time:  10:00 AM  
Venue:  Dental Ground  
Organized by:  
Association of Computer Engineers (ACE)  
& 
Association of Integrated Mechanical Engineering Students (AIMES)  
Sports Coordinators:  
Prof. Raghavendra Baliga  
Prof. Mahesh Kumar V B

Introduction:      
Srinivas Premier League (SPL) – Season 8 is an inter -departmental cricket 
tournament organized by the Association of Computer Engineers (ACE) and the 
Association of Integrated Mechanical Engineering Students (AIMES), Srinivas 
University Institute of Engine ering & Technology.  
The event was conducted with the objective of promoting sportsmanship, 
teamwork, leadership, and physical fitness among students. SPL has become one 
of the most awaited sporting events of the institution, providing students a 
platform to showcase their cri cketing talent while strengthening unity and 
coordination across departments.  
SPL Season 8 continued the legacy of previous seasons by bringing together 
enthusiastic players and supporters in a competitive yet friendly sporting 
atmosphere.  
  
  
Inauguration Session   
The event commenced with a formal inauguration ceremony at the Dental Ground 
at 10:00 AM.  
The Chief Guest of the event, Dr. Ramakrishna N Hegde (Dean, SUIET) , officially 
inaugurated the tournament. In his address, he emphasized the importance of 
balancing academics with sports and encouraged students to actively participate in 
extracurricular activities for overall personality development.  
The event was also graced by:  
• Dr. Shifana Begum (HoD, CSE)  
• Dr. K Rama Narasimha (HoD, Mechanical Engineering)  
Their presence motivated the participants and added significance to the occasion. 
They appreciated the efforts of the organizing committees and highlighted the 
importance of discipline, teamwork, and sportsmanship in student life.

Tournament Overview  
SPL Season 8 featured multiple student teams representing various classes and 
departments. The matches were conducted in a structured league format followed 
by knockout rounds.  
The tournament included:  
• Team registrations and auction process  
• League matches  
• Semi -final rounds  
• Grand Finale  
The matches were played with official cricket rules and supervised by sports 
coordinators and organizing committee members to ensure fair play and discipline.  
  
  
  
  
Participation & Performance  
The tournament witnessed enthusiastic participation from students across 
different departments. Each team displayed strong coordination, strategic 
planning, and competitive spirit.  
Players demonstrated:  
• Excellent batting and bowling performances  
• Strategic field placements  
• Effective teamwork and communication  
• Leadership skills under pressure  
The audience support and cheering added excitement and energy to the 
tournament, making it a vibrant campus event.

Event Highlights  
The major highlights of SPL Season 8 include:  
• Energetic inauguration ceremony  
• Strong inter -departmental participation  
• Competitive and well -disciplined matches  
• Active student involvement in organizing and volunteering  
• Encouragement of sportsmanship and unity  
• Enthusiastic crowd support  
• Memorable final match and prize distribution ceremony  
  
  
Prize Distribution  
The tournament concluded with a grand finale followed by a prize distribution 
ceremony. The winning team was awarded trophies and certificates in recognition 
of their outstanding performance.  
Individual awards were also presented for:  
• Best Batsman  
• Best Bowler  
• Man of the Match  
• Man of the Series  
The dignitaries congratulated all participants and appreciated the spirit of healthy 
competition displayed throughout the tournament.

Acknowledgment   
The successful organization of Srinivas Premier League – Season 8 was made 
possible through the constant support and encouragement of Dr. Ramakrishna N 
Hegde, Dean, SUIET . 
We extend our sincere gratitude to:  
• Dr. Shifana Begum, HoD – CSE 
• Dr. K Rama Narasimha, HoD – Mechanical Engineering  
• Sports Coordinators Prof. Raghavendra Baliga and Prof. Mahesh Kumar V B  
• Faculty members, organizing committee members, volunteers, and student 
coordinators  
Their dedication and teamwork ensured the smooth and successful conduct of the 
event.  
We also thank all the players and supporters for their active participation and 
enthusiasm.  
  
  
Conclusion   
Srinivas Premier League (SPL) – Season 8 successfully fulfilled its objective of 
promoting sports culture, teamwork, and leadership among students.  
The tournament not only provided a platform for showcasing cricketing talent but 
also strengthened unity and camaraderie within the campus. SPL Season 8 stands 
as a memorable sporting event that contributed to the holistic development of 
students and reinf orced the spirit of healthy competition.
